test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A boy read (3)/(8) of a book on one day and (4)/(5) of the remainder on another day. If there were 30 pages unread, how many pages did the book contain?
solution:
Given:

Book read by Boy in one day = (3)/(8) of total

(4)/(5) of the rest part was read in next day

Pages left to read = 30

Calculations:

After reading (3)/(8) of the book,

The remaining fraction 1 - (3)/(8) = (5)/(8)

The boy then reads (4)/(5) of (5)/(8) = (4)/(5) x (5)/(8) = (1)/(2)

Total fraction read = (3)/(8) + (1)/(2) = (7)/(8)

The unread fraction = 1 - (7)/(8) = (1)/(8)

This is equivalent to 30 pages (Given)

**∴ The book has (30)/((frac{1){8})} = 240 pages.**

Hence, the correct answer is** option 3).**
